description: This file defines the AddressHelper class for handling conversions between R1C1 and A1 cell address formats in PhpSpreadsheet, including formula conversions and coordinate parsing.

classes.name: AddressHelper
classes.description: Helper class for converting cell addresses between R1C1 and A1 formats and processing related formulas.

methods.name: getRowAndColumnChars
methods.description: Returns the row and column characters used in R1C1 notation, considering locale compatibility.

methods.name: convertToA1
methods.description: Converts an R1C1 format cell address to A1 format, considering current position and locale.

methods.name: convertSpreadsheetMLFormula
methods.description: Converts a SpreadsheetML formula string to a standard format by cleaning up references.

methods.name: convertFormulaToA1
methods.description: Converts formulas with R1C1 or SpreadsheetML references to A1 format, handling quoted strings.

methods.name: convertToR1C1
methods.description: Converts an A1 format cell address to R1C1 format, with support for relative addressing.
